summary: Startup and recovery failures retain error.resourceState = { report, close }, including when initial cleanup fails. Attempted generated container names enter the safe report before Docker run, so the caller can retry cleanup and report its final outcome while retaining the original failed operation status.

evidence.interface: On startup/recovery error, error.resourceState exposes only report and close; the success interface is unchanged.

evidence.command: Inline node --input-type=module harness replaces child_process.spawn through syncBuiltinESMExports, imports resources.mjs, and exercises two partial-startup cleanup failures and retries
cases: Container run returns an ID, then inspected port is non-loopback and initial cleanup inspection fails.

assertions: The original error remains an AggregateError containing the startup failure.
